objective: Reduce perceived and actual IGPAT first-frame startup and swipe latency on Android/Web using the installed Expo SDK 57 video system; preserve private media, sponsored Reels, audio mixing, Quick Edit and consolidated OTA hold.
productionBaselineEvidence: Inspected current GitHub main and existing Nov10 fast-playback scope and Nov11 consolidated OTA branches, but did not verify a live installed APK, exact production OTA source fingerprint, or runtime timings. User reports slow startup. This change remains isolated DEV; no production upload.
chosenApproach: Create one ahead VideoPlayer but mount VideoView only for the active reel. Measure native playback startup when the first frame actually renders rather than at playingChange, with a UI placeholder and direct user-gesture recovery for blocked/stalled autoplay. Lower normal-network initial buffer to 0.75s and keep conservative 1.5s buffer for weak-network/Data Saver. Render two feed cells up front. Apply to Android and Web only.
selectionRationale: Expo documentation supports preloading a player without a VideoView and onFirstFrameRender. Avoids simultaneous offscreen surfaces and background decoding pressure without replacing expo-video or rearchitecting signed URLs. Keeps existing progressive first-item signing and next organic clip preload.
acceptanceChecks: First video shows immediate loading state and clears it only after actual first frame, not merely player playing event
Healthy networks start at 0.75 second minimum buffer while weak network uses existing 1.5s
One next organic video preloads without rendering an offscreen video surface; no eager ad video preloading
Offscreen video never plays; on swipe back active video mounts its view
After 3 seconds without first frame the active clip offers direct tap-to-play recovery; no automatic unbounded request retry
Preserve signed private Supabase URLs and 8 minute account-scoped warm feed; do not persist URLs
Preserve Reels ad cadence, interactive gestures, web Quick Edit and PTT-compatible audioMixingMode
Focused Node regression plus TypeScript/CI gate; skipped real Android device test remains unverified
preserveBehaviors: Canonical BUKLOD navigation and legacy /reels alias
Supabase RLS and 20 minute signed media URLs
Native sponsored Reel slides and existing Google IMA branch
Data Saver/weak signal next preloading restrictions
Quick Edit trim/rotation/speed, temporary 2x long press and mute/audio mixing
No new native package, backend schema, paid encoding, cloud provider or direct production publish
riskAreas: First frame callback timing on Android SurfaceView
Fast swipe View mounting and pause/reuse
alternativeApproaches: Adopt new player or CDN/transcoding (rejected: new cost, backend and native upgrade)
Preload the entire feed (rejected: memory/data/permissions risk)
Play all adjacent videos offscreen (rejected: excessive decoder/audio usage)
Mount native VideoView only for active item while preloading VideoPlayer (selected)
